title: ImportDeploymentResult
description: Result of an import deployment operation, including a summary of imported, failed, and skipped objects, Admin Console settings, plug-ins, and database scripts.

summary.description: Summary of the import deployment operation results.

total.description: Total number of plug-ins in the package.

skipped.description: Number of plug-ins skipped during import.

databaseScripts.description: Number of database scripts executed during import.

deploymentLogUrl.description: URL to retrieve the full deployment log.

DeploymentStatus.description: The current status of a deployment operation. IN_PROGRESS indicates the operation is still running. COMPLETED indicates success. Other statuses indicate various error or review states.

ImportSummaryCount.description: Summary count of items in an import deployment, showing total, imported, failed, and skipped counts.

total.description: Total number of items in the package.

failed.description: Number of items that failed to import.

skipped.description: Number of items skipped during import.
